args: Run `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\mmass\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\exoplanet-explorer\sync_exoplanets.ps1` to query the NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP API (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/TAP/sync) and the Open Exoplanet Catalogue XML mirror (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenExoplanetCatalogue/open_exoplanet_catalogue) for the latest confirmed exoplanets and stellar host parameters. Verify that `C:\Users\mmass\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\exoplanet-explorer\data\exoplanets.json`, `data\exoplanets_bundle.js`, and `index.html` are updated, then deploy the updated build to Netlify site `25dfa895-4d8a-45bf-babd-e43c25b6856e` (https://astronav-exo-command.netlify.app) using the `netlify-deploy-services-updater` MCP tool.
description: Every hour at :00 (America/Chicago), queries the NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP API and Open Exoplanet Catalogue to update the local interactive Sci-Fi Exoplanet Observatory GUI and publishes the updated build to https://astronav-exo-command.netlify.app.
